sockets.description: LLRs (2 * y / sigma^2; positive favors bit 0).

notes: Bind the CP socket to the same float array as the channel, for example: std::vector<float> sigma(1, 0.5f); then modem_bpsk["demodulate::CP"] = sigma.data();

arguments.name: N
arguments.description: Frame size in symbols.

notes: For real BPSK symbols of amplitude 1, sigma = sqrt(1 / (2 * Es/N0)) with Es/N0 as a linear ratio.
Bind the CP socket to a float array holding sigma, for example: std::vector<float> sigma(1, 0.5f); then channel_awgn_llr["add_noise::CP"] = sigma.data();
The constructor also accepts a Gaussian generator implementation and a seed after N.

modules.summary: Cyclic redundancy check: appends, removes or checks CRC bits.

arguments.name: K
arguments.description: Number of information bits, CRC bits excluded.

arguments.name: poly_key
arguments.description: Known polynomial name such as "16-CCITT", "11-5G" or "4-ITU", or a hexadecimal value such as "0x8005".

arguments.name: size
arguments.description: CRC size in bits; 0 takes it from a named polynomial, required with a hexadecimal value.

sockets.name: U_K2
sockets.description: Information bits followed by the CRC bits.

sockets.name: V_K
sockets.description: Bits to check; the task status tells whether the CRC matches.

notes: A CRC-aided decoder takes this module as constructor argument; its K and the encoder K are then K + size.

arguments.name: K
arguments.description: Number of information bits (CRC bits included when a CRC is used).

arguments.name: N
arguments.description: Codeword length, a power of two.

arguments.name: frozen_bits
arguments.description: N flags, true for a frozen bit.

notes: Build frozen_bits before the encoder and decoder, for example with the Gaussian approximation at a design noise level: aff3ct::tools::Frozenbits_generator_GA_Arikan frozen_bits_generator(K, N); aff3ct::tools::Sigma<> design_sigma(0.5f); frozen_bits_generator.set_noise(design_sigma); std::vector<bool> frozen_bits(N); frozen_bits_generator.generate(frozen_bits); (true marks a frozen bit). A fixed frozen set can also be written directly into the vector.
Frozenbits_generator_5G reads conf/cde/awgn_polar_codes/5G/N_1024.pc from the AFF3CT 'conf' submodule, which hulotte deps install does not fetch.

modules.summary: Bit and frame error counter (BER/FER) with a stopping criterion.

arguments.name: K
arguments.description: Number of bits compared per frame.

arguments.name: max_fe
arguments.description: Number of frame errors after which fe_limit_achieved() returns true.

notes: After the run: get_n_analyzed_fra(), get_n_fe(), get_n_be(), get_fer() and get_ber(); reset() before the next SNR point.
Stop the simulation loop when fe_limit_achieved() is true; an optional third argument max_n_frames also bounds the frame count (frame_limit_achieved()).
